words.meaning: A feeling of vexation, distress, or humiliation arising from disappointment or failure
words.sentence1: Much to her chagrin, the surprise party was revealed before she could arrange the final decorations. (Much to her chagrin, the surprise party was revealed before she could arrange the final decorations.)
words.sentence2: He swallowed his chagrin and politely applauded his rival's unexpected victory. (He swallowed his chagrin and politely applauded his rival's unexpected victory.)

words.meaning: A feeling of joyful hope, enthusiasm, or eager anticipation for the future
words.sentence1: Ella preparo el viaje con muchisima ilusion y entusiasmo. (She prepared the journey with immense eager anticipation and enthusiasm.)
words.sentence2: Ver a su familia reunida le devolvio la ilusion de seguir adelante. (Seeing his family reunited brought back his hopeful enthusiasm to carry on.)

words.meaning: A profound feeling of complete emotional fulfillment, inner peace, and wholeness
words.sentence1: Assise au sommet de la colline, elle ressentit une profonde sensation de plenitude. (Sitting atop the hill, she felt a profound feeling of complete fulfillment.)
words.sentence2: Ce moment de calme absolu a apporte une plenitude inattendue a son esprit fatigue. (This moment of absolute calm brought an unexpected wholeness to his tired mind.)

words.meaning: A deep state of emotional being-moved, solemn awe, or stirring reverence
words.sentence1: Nach dem emotionalen Klavierkonzert herrschte im Saal eine tiefe Ergriffenheit. (After the emotional piano concert, a deep solemn awe prevailed throughout the hall.)
words.sentence2: Die Zuhoerer lauschten der Rede seiner Mutter mit stiller Ergriffenheit. (The listeners paid attention to his mother's speech with quiet emotional reverence.)

words.meaning: A deep sense of peace of mind, soothing comfort, and inner tranquility
words.sentence1: Atatakai cha o nomi nagara, kokoro no yasuragi o kanjimashita. (While drinking warm tea, I felt a soothing peace of mind.)
words.sentence2: Kare no yasashii koe wa fuan na kanojo ni yasuragi o ataemashita. (His gentle voice provided tranquility to her anxious heart.)

words.meaning: An emotional sensation of deep affection, gentleness, and warm fondness
words.sentence1: Guardare quel cucciolo che dormiva le ha riempito il cuore di tenerezza. (Looking at that sleeping puppy filled her heart with tenderness.)
words.sentence2: Le sue parole piene di tenerezza hanno confortato il caro amico in lutto. (His words filled with tenderness comforted his dear mourning friend.)

words.meaning: A state of longing, eager yearning, or visionary aspiration filled with affection
words.sentence1: Shaonian de xinzhong chongmanle dui weilai meihao shenghuo de chongjing. (The youth's heart was filled with yearning and aspiration for a beautiful future life.)
words.sentence2: Tamen huai zhe dui yuanfang de chongjing tashangle xin de zhengcheng. (Holding a romantic longing for distant lands, they set off on a new journey.)

words.meaning: A deep feeling of tender sympathy, sorrowful empathy, and compassionate love
words.sentence1: Geuneun gyeongjejeog-eulo eolyeoun ius-ege gipeun yeonmin-eul neukkyeossda. (He felt deep compassion and empathy toward his financially struggling neighbors.)
words.sentence2: Seoro-reul hyanghan yeonmin-ui maeum-i geudeul-ui sangcheo-reul chiyuhayeossda. (Their mutual feeling of tender compassion healed their emotional wounds.)

words.meaning: A state of profound compassion, merciful kindness, and heartfelt empathy toward others
words.sentence1: Neak mean chet karuna taeng-te chuoy-os-pi-chet dol monus del kran-kro. (A person with compassionate kindness always helps impoverished people from the heart.)
words.sentence2: Krom-kru-pet ban samdaeng karuna yang chrov-chrov champo neak-chmheu. (The medical staff expressed profound compassionate empathy toward the patients.)

words.meaning: A deep, warm feeling of heartfelt compassion, pity, and tender empathy
words.sentence1: Sy het met opregte deernis na die hartseer verhaal van die vlugteling geluister. (She listened with genuine compassion to the refugee's heartbreaking story.)
words.sentence2: Die verpleegster se deernis het dadelik troos gebring aan die eensame pasiënt. (The nurse's tender empathy immediately brought comfort to the lonely patient.)
